The '''''Hyena''-class bomber''', also known simply as the '''''Hyena'' droid bomber, ''Hyena'' Droid '''or '''Hyena bomber''', was a [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighter]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a heavy ordnance craft during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Hyena bomber also was used as a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], but only when needed. Due to its restricted availability, the ''Hyena''-class bomber was missing in many key battles. The bomber saw service in different campaigns on planets such as [[Christophsis]], [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] and [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HyenaBomber2-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|''Hyena''-class bomber in "walker" mode.]]
The ''Hyena''-class bomber was similar in design to the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class fighter]], but had a broader fuselage and two "head" units.<ref name="LG">{{WebCite|url=http://www.brickshelf.com/cgi-bin/gallery.cgi?i=3388383|text=Brickshelf LEGO gallery|archivedate=20080920024759}}</ref> Unlike the Vulture Droid, the Hyena bomber's wings separated in the middle while in "walker" mode.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> Underneath the second, immobile head, there appeared to be a red [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] protruding from the blue hull. The ''Hyena''-class bomber was capable of carrying at least two<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]],<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles" /> six [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and six light [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] inside the bomb bay beneath the hull. The Hyena bomber also carried two [[Laser cannon/Legends|light laser cannons]] which eliminated the need for [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] escort.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Roles==
The ''Hyena''-class bomber was originally designed as an air-to-surface [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> With its twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and maneuverability, the Hyena bomber also was used as a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] but only to support other fighters.<ref name="Droids Over Iego">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/droids_over_iego|text=Droids Over Iego|int=Droids Over Iego}}</ref><ref name="Gunship Over Florrum">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/gunship|text=Gunship Over Florrum|int=Gunship Over Florrum}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|It appears a surrender is unnecessary. We will all perish for the ''glory'' of the Separatist Alliance.|[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], as Hyena bombers approach|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
The Hyena bomber was first introduced in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] as a cheaper, more maneuverable bomber by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> Ten of these bombers were first stationed aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|blockade]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. They were later used to bomb the surface.<ref name="CaM" />

The ''Hyena''-class bombers were seen during the [[Fall of Falleen]], early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] completely eradicated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] force stationed there and proceeded to attack the fortress of the King. There, they shelled the capital, but could not penetrate the defensive shield surrounding the palace of the [[Unidentified King of Falleen|Falleen King]].<ref name="webcomic2">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/comic/?book=season1#/?page=45|text=''The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen'' (p.43)|nobackup=1}}</ref>

After a Separatist [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Starship]] flew over [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], the Hyena bomber proved itself as a fighter. The Separatists deployed Hyena bombers along with other [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] with the mission to shoot down [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|recon ship]] that was tasked with a recon mission. The gunship shot down all of the bombers and other craft including [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], then returned to Secura's [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Gunship Over Florrum" />

[[File:Hyenas_in_formation.png|thumb|left|300px|''Hyena''s receive orders to bomb [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] while in flight.]]
The ''Hyena''-class bombers also found use during a battle on planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Lead by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in her ship the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']], a squad of bombers was tasked with destroying a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]]. The bombers managed to take out one support cable causing the structure to become unstable and toppled several [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] slaves into lava. The bombers then turned around and began to attack again, but were then destroyed when a [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] shot a proton bomb underneath one of the bombers. After having her bomber squad destroyed, Ventress requested more from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] who was in the process of retreat. Ventress then proceeded to attack but was forced to follow Grievous in retreat.<ref name="Slaves6" />

Bombers were also in use during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. First, Hyena bombers were ordered to carpet bomb all of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] villages, as a last ditch effort to destroy what couldn't be taken. While regrouping, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|CC-6454]] witnessed one of these attacks and reported it to General [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Windu then ordered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to take a Republic squadron and eliminate the bombers. Before Separatist leader [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] fled the city, his [[TA-175/Legends|Tactical droid]] ordered a nearby group of ''Hyena''-class bombers in flight to destroy the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], and Tambor himself. The bombers were in sight of the city but were destroyed at the last second by Skywalker and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

[[File:Hyena_bomber_prep_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|right|300px|''Hyena'' bombers in walker mode]]
Hyena bombers were also used by [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] in his [[Droid Army]] over the planet of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. They attacked a lone [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|scout]] fighter sent by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|General Kenobi]] to report on the mysterious activity in an area called "[[Thicket|The Thicket]]." The lone fighter destroyed the bombers and other droid forces sent by HELIOS-3D. The fighter returned and Generals Skywalker and Kenobi began to board HELIOS-3D's [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. After having his forces defeated, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] transferred his consciousness into a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and left his body in his command ship.<ref name="Droids Over Iego" />

These bombers were also present at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], where they attacked Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] and other targets. Many of the Hyena bombers were shot down by [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]] but the disabled bombers ended up crashing into Republic armored columns, achieving much the same effect, weakening the Republic forces during the battle. It was only the use of the experimental [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] that secured a Republic victory, although its use awoke a fearsome [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]].<ref name="TCW:TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

[[File:HyenaSuicideBomber-Nightsisters.png|thumb|300px|left|A heavily damaged ''Hyena'' committing a suicide run.]]
Hyena bombers were commanded by Ventress in the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]] against a Republic fleet led by both Skywalker and Kenobi. After Ventress personally joined the battle and engaged the two, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was ordered by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to have his elite [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] eliminated. [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]], the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] in charge of Ventress' forces, was assigned this task by the Count. After ordering her [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] to fire upon the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|command ship]] where Ventress and the two Jedi dueled, TJ-912 contacted one of her bombers and ordered it to calculate its flight path to terminate in the flagship's main hangar. The bomber then flew directly through cannonfire and went flying on its [[Ramming/Legends|suicide run]] into the hangar as commanded, crashing and almost hitting Skywalker, Kenobi and Ventress, who barely managed to jump out of its way. Despite the immense damage to the command ship and the suicide bomber, the three combatants were able to escape the dreadnaught's destruction.

During the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]] several landing craft and Vulture Droids launched from the [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] and headed towards Dathomir. Soon when the battle started Ventress saw [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid fighters]] in the sky. A couple of Hyena bombers bombed the surface of Dathomir, damaging the entrance to the [[Nightsister fortress]].

Hyena bombers were also seen in the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion of Scipio]]. The Hyena bombers were used for the first attack on [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. The Vulture Droids and Hyena bombers flew on to the planet and bombed the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] and then stayed there with the Vultures. Soon when Anakin lead his attack on Scipio, a squad of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] lead by [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] headed to the Separatist ships. Several Vulture Droids and Hyena bombers launched from on top of the Count Dooku's Dreadnaught and his [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ships]]. The Hyena bombers passed the Headhunters while the Vulture Droids engaged them. When Count Dooku retreated with his ships, the Hyena bombers and Vulture Droids left too while Anakin and his gunships passed. When Anakin's gunships were closer to the landing platform on Scipio, Several Vulture Droids and Hyena bombers that stayed launched and headed towards the Gunships and Hawk's fighters. The Hyena bombers were destroyed at first which then only left the Vulture Droids to engage the Headhunters.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Hyena'' droid bomber was first revealed through images of its [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO]] model in 2009. It can also be briefly seen in the non-canon video [[LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2 (film)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2'']].
